commands.allowedCommands.description: Commands that can be auto-executed when 'Always approve execute operations' is enabled
commands.deniedCommands.description: Command prefixes that will be automatically denied without asking for approval. In case of conflicts with allowed commands, the longest prefix match takes precedence. Add * to deny all commands.
commands.commandExecutionTimeout.descrip: Maximum time in seconds to wait for command execution to complete before timing out (0 = no timeout, 1-600s, default: 0s)
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.descripti: Settings for VSCode Language Model API
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.vendor.de: The vendor of the language model (e.g. copilot)
settings.vsCodeLmModelSelector.family.de: The family of the language model (e.g. gpt-4)
settings.customStoragePath.description: Custom storage path. Leave empty to use the default location. Supports absolute paths (e.g. 'D:\VibeCodeStorage')
settings.autoImportSettingsPath.descript: Path to a VibeCode configuration file to automatically import on extension startup. Supports absolute paths and paths relative to the home directory (e.g. '~/Documents/vibe-code-settings.json'). Leave empty to disable auto-import.
settings.language.description: Preferred UI and assistant response language. Synced to the in-app Settings panel on startup.
settings.tone.description: Conversational tone the assistant uses. Korean: formal=격식체, casual=친근체, terse=간결. English speakers can leave as-is.
settings.autonomy.description: Agent autonomy preset. safe=ask for everything, assist=read auto/edit ask (default), auto=read+edit auto/commands ask, yolo=all auto. Applied on activation when no explicit per-tool overrides exist.

settings.checkpointBeforeDestructive.des: Before an approved destructive command runs, snapshot uncommitted changes to tracked files and untracked files alike (ignored files excluded) into refs/vibe-checkpoints, and write a note with restore commands under .vibe-code/checkpoints. Your working tree, index and stash stack are left untouched.
